error[ZBX-E0706]: the state volume is in use
  while  taking the state volume pgdata
  cause  pg (process 4242) holds the volume pgdata for writing
  volume pgdata
  fix    stop the container that holds it, then run again:   zbx stop pg
         or, if this run only reads it, mount it with NAME:PATH:ro
  more   zbx explain E0706
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0706.html
